trigger: after both first selected sites had incomplete reported date labels in all four 2016-2019 station-years
selection: the remaining two non-buoy options with river/stream metadata and four QA-envelope years with provider record counts above an hourly sampling necessary-count heuristic; counts can include other parameters and are not proof of 24-hour water-temperature observations
not_selected: BFBM000237 is described as a bog and is not presumed a river; buoys in coastal waters remain excluded; other seasonal or missing-span stations remain unresolved
data_and_analysis: download provider temperature CSVs into local private storage; read only station, timestamp and timezone columns for an optimistic date-label upper bound; no temperature values used for recovery-model scores
interpretation: post-hoc availability-selected exploration; four nonzero or high count years do not imply full 24-hour observations, QA, nonestimated temperatures, time-zone correctness or independent watersheds

identity_source_correction.reason: The presumed Water Quality Portal deep link was not verified; both named river-site identities are explicitly listed in the official NJDEP map and QAPP. Selection and years were not changed.
